How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Bhopal Project Technical Support - III Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 04-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Bhopal Project Technical Support - III recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Project Technical Support - III post is 04-10-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit for the Project Technical Support - III position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Technical Support - III position is 35 years, with relaxations applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 33,600/-.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email to the address specified in the official notification before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: A three-year graduate degree in a relevant subject with three years of experience, or a PG degree, or a four-year graduate degree in Engineering/IT/CS is required. Desirable qualifications include MPH or related public health/psychology/nursing/physiotherapy degrees.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for any category.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test, followed by an Interview, and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where is AIIMS Bhopal located?
faq.answer: AIIMS Bhopal is located in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, with the pincode 462020.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The position of Project Technical Support - III is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. When is the walk-in date for the recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in date for the recruitment process, including the written test and interview, is 06-10-2026.
